name: pam_touchid
detailed_description: PAM module enabling fingerprint authentication via macOS TouchID. Allows users to authenticate using biometric fingerprint instead of password, exclusive to Apple Silicon and Intel Macs with Touch Bar.

parameters.fallback_auth: Allow password fallback if TouchID fails

notes:
macOS only. Requires Touch ID capable hardware. Part of macOS security framework.
